# Alcohol and cancer prevention

## Recommendation

For cancer prevention, it is best not to drink alcohol. All types of alcoholic drinks, including wine, beer and spirits, increase the risk of cancer. The more alcohol a person drinks, the higher the risk of cancer.

## Alcohol and tobacco

The combined use of alcohol and tobacco multiplies the risk of cancers of the mouth, throat and oesophagus compared with using either one alone.
